title: A draft PR that no live session owns and no doing step names closes as stale
why: The open-PR count was 763 at 21:00 CST Nov 9; the owner wants it down to live work (owner chat 21:27 and 21:29 CST: "the amt of open prs we have now is not best practices"). PASS RESULT 17:11 CST Nov 14 (the 16:34 CST Nov 14 Status tab republish; triage read no PR): 170 draft PRs over 12 hours old with no live lane (#3111 to #3396, oldest first; the full list is in the build's upkeep line in roadmap 745162559); nothing closed; closing is the batch runner's act (ruling pr-close-by-batch-runner). Open question for the coordinator: which of the 170 are still wanted (not read). Build caveats: the page file is 14.0 MB of the 16 MB cap; PR rows carry no head shas, so rows that read a head show unknown; 2067 session rows carried unverified, so the build's 384 stalled-step lines are unknown; the build's hint "set to done: landed in #..." for records-page-before-ready is wrong (#3396 and #3426 are open).
note: Starts after close-replaced-at-open. Goal: open PRs are live work only. Test: no live (unarchived) session owns the draft PR, and no step marked doing names it. Then it closes as stale with a comment that names why; its branch stays, and it reopens on need. The first pass is a preview list for the coordinator's read before any close. Filed from coordinator 21:34 CST, corrected 21:35 CST (dropped a 7-day no-commit test as an unmeasured fixed value).
